provenance.evidence: EquiVM v4.29.0 -> v4.33.1, run 5 residue, Reasoning/SolcRoutines.lean 1464-1509 (38 sites, all in RD.solcErrorStringCopyReverts): `simpa only [u256_add_assoc] using hwf.dN` gives `Type mismatch: After simplification`. The goal keeps `pc + (UInt256.ofNat 2 + { val := 1 })` and `Operation.Push Operation.POp.PUSH3`; the term has `pc + { val := 3 }` and the abbrev `Operation.PUSH3`. The two sides are equal at default transparency, not at reducible transparency. Measured on an untracked copy of the module, one site per copy: `using` -> `using!` removed the site's error at 38 of 38 sites (38 -> 37 errors, no warning in the node); all 38 edits together gave 0 errors. Run 5 tried `simpaToExact` (fails: `exact` gets no reassociation) and `simpaSplit` (wrote `simp ... at hwf.d3`, which Lean refuses). LiteralForm measured Examples Vault.Dispatch 270 (the same message, `{ val := N }` against `UInt256.ofNat N`): `using!` removed the error (47 -> 46).

introduced_by.commit: v4.31.0 #13636 (simpa using closes at reducible transparency); #13833 adds `simpa ... using!`, the previous close. The v4.31.0 release notes name this migration: switch `simpa using` to `simpa using!`.
